Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE polished Star Trek Armada II mod design board, tall 3-column by 5-row grid on dark navy. Each panel contains one complete isolated upgraded game asset, consistent isometric view and scale appropriate to role. Every faction must have a genuinely distinct silhouette and its own consistent architectural family across all three roles, not palette swaps. Federation: sleek ivory saucer engineering ship with exposed crystal cargo tanks, clean twin freight berths refinery, advanced orbital science campus with central sensor dome and radial laboratory wings, cyan and blue lighting.
